name: VallaTech Summit
shortDescription: Encuentro anual de la comunidad tecnológica de Valladolid, con charlas, talleres y networking sobre inteligencia artificial, cloud y ciberseguridad. Es el DevFest que organiza GDG Valladolid, con marca y web propias.

shortDescriptionI18n.en: The annual gathering of the Valladolid tech community, with talks, workshops and networking on artificial intelligence, cloud and cybersecurity. It is the DevFest organised by GDG Valladolid, with its own brand and website.
